caption: A balloon drifts across the beam of a projector during a slideshow, and its dark silhouette appears on the screen over the slides.

sa.check: A projector shows slides on a screen.
A balloon drifts across the beam.
Its silhouette appears on the screen over the slides.
The balloon enters the beam first and the silhouette appears with it.

pc.expect: The silhouette appears where the balloon blocks the beam and moves with it.
pc.fail: The silhouette appears with the balloon outside the beam; or it stays still while the balloon drifts; or it moves the opposite way.

pc.expect: The slide image is missing inside the silhouette and returns when the balloon has passed.
pc.fail: The slide shows through the silhouette; or the silhouette leaves a dark patch after the balloon has gone; or the silhouette is a different shape from the balloon.

pc.expect: The silhouette does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It drifts with the balloon still; or it appears before the balloon enters; or it lingers after the balloon has left.

pc.expect: The balloon drifts gently and does not shoot or drop like a stone.
pc.fail: It shoots off; or drops like a stone; or hangs rigidly still in a draught.

pc.expect: One balloon and one silhouette; the projector and screen stay one each.
pc.fail: A second silhouette appears under one beam; or the balloon vanishes; or the silhouette becomes solid; or the balloon passes through the screen.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The balloon's colour and the slides stay the same, and the silhouette stays dark.
pc.fail: The balloon changes colour; or the silhouette turns bright; or the slide changes with no click.
